title: Parse comma-separated key=value pairs with double-quoted values containing commas
task_prompt: Fix the bug in `src/kv_parser.py` so that all tests in `tests/test_kv_parser.py` pass. You may only modify `src/kv_parser.py`.

reference_fix.new_str:
segments: list[str] = []
    buf: list[str] = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(line):
        ch = line[i]
        if ch == "\\" and in_quotes and i + 1 < len(line):
            buf.append(ch)
            buf.append(line[i + 1])
            i += 2
            continue
        if ch == '"':
            in_quotes = not in_quotes
            buf.append(ch)
        elif ch == "," and not in_quotes:
            segments.append("".join(buf))
            buf = []
        else:
            buf.append(ch)
        i += 1
    if in_quotes:
        raise ValueError("Unclosed double quote in line")
    segments.append("".join(buf))

    for part in segments:
        if "=" not in part:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing '=' in segment: {part!r}")
        key, raw_val = part.split("=", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError("Key must not be empty")
        val = raw_val.strip()
        if len(val) >= 2 and val.startswith('"') and val.endswith('"'):
            val = val[1:-1].replace('\\"', '"').replace('""', '"')
        result[key] = val
